content: Supabase free-tier projects pause after ~7 days with no database activity (measured by real API/DB requests, not dashboard views). Two warning emails are sent before pausing. A paused project returns HTTP 540 on every request (DB, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions all down at once); data is retained and restorable for up to 1 year. Programmatic detection: treat any 540 (or connection failure) from Supabase as 'paused', distinct from a normal outage. Prevention workarounds: scheduled GitHub Actions ping, or upgrade to Pro (5/mo, removes pausing) — out of scope per this project's free-tier-only constraint.
